summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in api-anthropic@0.1.0
details: Package api-anthropic@0.1.0 was scanned across 8 files. No install-time or import-time execution of remote code was observed, no credential or filesystem harvesting was traced, and no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations were identified. The package name resembles the Anthropic vendor namespace, which is worth noting as a potential source of naming confusion, but name similarity alone is not a supply-chain threat and no malicious code path was found in the shipped contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
